name: Circuit Fabology Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Circuit Fabology Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, sales, and maintenance of direct imaging equipment and direct writing lithography equipment in Chinese Mainland, Thailand, Japan, Taiwan China, and worldwide.
